# ReelFarm

> An independent, done-for-you short-form video production studio for businesses, professionals, and creators.

ReelFarm handles research, content ideas, scriptwriting, animated comedy, educational explainers, promotional videos, 3D visuals, motion graphics, and client-supplied footage editing. Finished videos are delivered ready to post. Production can be requested in English, Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese.

The website showcases real studio-supplied portfolio pieces and creative concepts. Examples do not imply paid client engagements or guaranteed performance. There are no accounts, DIY video-generation tools, or checkout.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Services, portfolio, production process, and FAQs.
- [Explore](/explore): Nine portfolio videos with durations, language metadata, descriptions, and creative categories.
- [Packages](/packages): Content (5–7 videos per week), Growth (up to 2 videos per day), Creator (custom scope). Prices are quoted individually.
- [Quote](/quote): Prepares a project brief in the visitor's email app. The visitor must send it manually.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact options.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Actual information handling and browser storage.

Spanish pages use /es; Brazilian Portuguese pages use /pt. Video language is independent of website language.
